svg.text: An arrow A → B: A needs B. The rooms and the house know each other only through the interfaces room.js and shell.js (root); apps.dat.js names the implementations; core and library know no project.
root — the menu and the interfaces
core/ — shared code, knows no project

svg.text: uses (calls what the file defines); colour = the folder of the user
loaded on demand (through an interface, or its own files)

Thick arrow from a page into core/, library/ or the CDN: its arrows to the files named on it (* a tag only). Pages have a dark frame; under each name its size on disk. Hover an arrow for its two files. Not drawn: *.md (docs), archon/ (the drawings building.dat.js comes from).
